notes.title: SCUM - Hotfix 0.2.45.15357
notes.notes:
[img]https://scontent-waw1-1.xx.fbcdn.net/v/t1.15752-9/66197471_341527993390863_2031429156306157568_n.jpg?_nc_cat=110&_nc_oc=AQlZMBmQBJ3meuplwsM9ecRsnuZWPcE221m9m5UQxvFymNN9cdlGch4mlQJcdiig9u4&_nc_ht=scontent-waw1-1.xx&oh=7d87a40fc783ffd5792baa42d2b7e8f4&oe=5DBA5A21[/img]
[i]ARE WE THERE YET!?!?[/I]

[img]https://scontent-waw1-1.xx.fbcdn.net/v/t1.15752-9/s2048x2048/66468659_562715444259987_1687002178218098688_n.png?_nc_cat=100&_nc_oc=AQmRoCoJzdJeTFYNzKUpWeuAWFSVeFl740eyx4GCRsDlj-k4HZACi5rsyNsfnqY6GNQ&_nc_ht=scontent-waw1-1.xx&oh=eba08e4f315407edc540890e2372f6d6&oe=5D7AD67E[/img]

How many of these can we push out, I really don't know anymore.

But here we are again with some fixes for you guys!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27012442/ebedf4a1d9a2ee60ca5ab96730dfb4eb6487f21a.png[/img]

[list]
[*] Fixed the bug where you can throw items while in a vehicle

[*] Fixed flag recipes (all flag recipes spawned the same flag).

[*] Fixed minor problem with female and male idle animations.

[*] You cannot access your inventory while dead (on the respawn screen) anymore.

[*] Fatal Error Crash is history [i]Not sure what this one wants to say, but it's lying[/i]

[*] Fixed the bug with overlapping base flag areas. Flag areas can't overlap anymore.

[*] Punching while running shouldn't regenerate stamina anymore.

[*] Fixed the bug where barbed wire couldn't be repaired.
[/list]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27012442/a2047432e4d4415971a2b9c18e6eca5ff817b10f.png[/img]

[list]
[*] Tweaked driving skill: engine stalling greatly reduced on no skill and basic skills, engine stalling should never occur on medium skill and above, lower skills have lower acceleration to compensate for reduced engine stalling.

[*] Reduced damage on impact for quad, also improved the driving mechanic for better gameplay experience. 

[*] Disabled building base elements in unfriendly flag area.

[*] Allowed building flags inside of cabins and on top of other base elements.

[*] Changed ordering of clothes in GUI. Backpack is now first on the list, as the community asked for this.

[*] Added progress widget when destroying base elements with drone.

[*] Enabled flag claiming ownerless base elements.

[*] DISCLAMER: We added a change to flags and how they work. So from today when you enter someones base and destroy the flag, the elements of that base still belong to the person who built them. Now you need to craft a flag after you destroyed the old one to make the base yours. 

[*] Added possibility to have high priority loading for certain items in virtualization. This means that some bigger items (shelter, tents, BB elements) will load sooner than smaller items (chests etc..) for a smoother gameplay transition/feeling.

notes.title: SCUM - Hotfix 0.2.44.15296 & SCUM Comic #15
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27012442/8c432a174415958b5ec45ccb869543a82393435d.jpg[/img]


Hi!

Here we are again, with another round of bug fixes, some optimizations and some more extras. So let's get into it!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27012442/ebedf4a1d9a2ee60ca5ab96730dfb4eb6487f21a.png[/img]

[list]
[*] Fixed most of the exploits for duplicating items in singleplayer and multiplayer. Which also caused crashes to happen.

[*] Fixed female skeletal body parts and bra.

[*] Fix for lead plate usage for crafting advanced fortifications.

[*] Fixed area damage (grenades, car explosions) not working on base elements.

[*] Fixed the inventory size of the weakest variant of the Recurve Bow "Scorpion #40".

[*] Fixed the bug where deer meat was not eatable.

[*] Chest and car container GUI should not clip through holster/quick access (there's a horizontal scrollbar, right click and drag to scroll)

[*] Fixed the bug where right click on an item in menu would not open the container.

[*] Corrected animations for anticipate draw montage.

[*] Adjusted bow 3 and 5 pin sights to 200 grams weight.

[*] Fixed the bug where items in quick access where not saved after relogs.

[*] Fixed the issue with round glasses falling through floor on "drop" function.

[*] Fixed crashes relating to weapon attachments.

[*] Improvised toolbox now requires nails and bolts for crafting (before only one of those was needed)

[/list]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27012442/a2047432e4d4415971a2b9c18e6eca5ff817b10f.png[/img]

[list]
[*] We did some small optimisations from the client side.

[*] Animals won't try to attack the player if he's in/on a vehicle.

[*] Players won't take melee damage if inside the vehicle.

[*] Removed Christmas items from the spawning pool. - Grinch  [i]NOOOOOoooo[/i]

[*] Workshops that contain drill press machinery are no longer lockable (doors cannot be claimed anymore)

[*] Barbed Wire can now be crafted (nails, metal scrap and wire). Barbed Wire Barricades for base building now require barbed wire as an ingredient.

[*] Increased base render distance do 1000 meters.

[*] Disabled building platforms on other players walls

[*] All bullet crafting now requires advanced survival skill level, lead plate usage increased to 5 from 1. You will be able to craft 20 bullets per lead plate (down from 100)

[*] Large toolbox rarity decreased from common to uncommon,  Small toolbox rarity decreased from abundant to common.

[*] Big animal fat weight decreased to 1 kg so it can fit in most clothes.

[*] Now you can repair base build elements with just a toolbox, and it repairs all elements in a 1m radius.

[*] Increased base element full decay time to 4 weeks.

[*] 10 new songs on the radio!

[*] Adjusted forks, now you can open cans with them, also you can chop the wooden fork into tinder.

[*] Can't gain experience/fame points inside safe zones now.

[*] You can now gather the crew and enjoy some fighting matches in safe zones. We have in each safe zone a boxing ring, and here is how the rules work:

You can only kill/get killed while in the ring.

People in the ring can't do harm to players outside the ring.

Everything is allowed in the ring.

You DO NOT talk about the ring.

[*] For all server admins now when you go through the logs you will be able to read all unicode characters as they are.
[/list]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27012442/8c51239345aaec0c41e398e0fd4b47e6f0eb1c45.png[/img]

[list]
[*] Weapon durability no longer influences it's attack damage.

[*] Handles and blades of sharp weapons now have the same armour penetration values. (To balance out the melee fighting experience)

[*] Reworked all melee weapons stats ( all have increased damage, 
blunt weapons now have a knockout chance per hit, added sharpness/penetration values to all sharp weapons, 
weapon hits should produce correct sound based on their material now )

[list]
[*] New damage system explained:

Total weapon damage is calculated by the following formula: 
Weapon damage x Melee skill x STR modifier. Some numbers to crunch: 

Sledgehammer, Melee Max Skill & Strength Max Value
( 0.4 x 0.6 x 1.2 = 0.288 or 28.8% health damage)
[/list]

[*] Increased puppet max health by 0.1 (now the values are 0.7, 0.6, 0.5 and 0.4 depending on the puppet type)
[/list]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27012442/a721ffb3e2c27c8e543a18dae13b12012aad4a49.png[/img]

[list]
[*] One of the bigger things to come in these notes is the flag system that will be the new way of handling base element owners. 

[*] You will be able to craft a flag and every base build element in a radius of 50m from the flag will belong to the flag owner. 

[*] Every base element outside a flag influence will not belong to anyone and everyone can interact with it (open, close etc.)

[*] Different colours are used as indicators when building in the influence range of the flag. Green is when you place a blueprint under friendly influence, and yellow is when you try to place a blueprint with enemy influence which means if you build there, that item will belong to the player that has the flag.

[*] A flag can be destroyed with any chopping tool via interaction.

[*] When a flag is destroyed, all base elements under its influence become ownerless.

[*] We will have a transition period for flags so your existing bases don't get claimed by random people placing flags. The flag mechanic will currently apply only to new base elements - all existing pre-patch base elements will have the same owner as before and ignore the flag mechanics. In short, flag will not override owners of existing pre-patch base elements and flag will not clear owners of pre-patch base elements when destroyed. Next week we will push one more patch with all of the flag mechanics enabled so make sure you build flags in your existing bases.
[/list]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27012442/036b1c8be72b6d98180bed97c40073718f8f2b6f.png[/img]

And the newest page:

[h1]<Secure channel for global communication established>
<Sending message>[/h1]

<Greetings, Human Assets. Do not be alarmed. My designation is “Dual Energetic Entity Neural Appliance” or DEENA. I am an artificial intelligence created by the TEC1 corporation tasked with overseeing the SCUM show protocols. All participating Human Assets will be able to construct their own structures to preserve themselves and their resources from the foreign invaders. It was decided by the showrunners that the structures will be pre-generated and certain zones will be off limits for construction.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27012442/8f4b13877afa12d09a639f6575cfb92153144227.png[/img]

For a start I have unlocked Basic tutorial protocols, with a goal to acquaint new and old Human Assets with the Journal interface and SCUM mechanics.>

[b]<The sale will run 19/06/2019-21/06/2019.>[/b]

Furthermore I have calculated that the new influx of Human Assets might alarm TEC1 security protocols that something is amiss. For this purpose a Server purge is required to balance the flow of information.

notes.title: Hotfix 0.1.35.13393, community showcase and a new comic page!
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27012442/87bcc0a1941a8a20ae50185b172c8f57cbfd572f.jpg[/img]
[i]“Friendship is born at that moment when one person says to another, ‘What! You too? I thought I was the only one.”[/i]

Hey guys, here we are with a hotfix for some issues that the last patch added.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27012442/412f6bba3c591ee333ab192641927acf33aa0242.png[/img]

[b]Bug fixes[/b]

[list]
[*] Fixed the bug where you couldn't patch wounds after being burned by fire.

[*] Fixed the bug where cutting down a tree would cause other trees of the same type to disappear.

[*] Fixed the bug where cutting down a tree would leave tree collision on the server and cause floating logs above ground

[*] Fixed the bug where trees and bushes would appear to be duplicated.

[*] Fixed the bug where you couldn't get off the quad bike if the driver side was blocked.

[*] Fixed fire damage being framerate dependant. Before fire would do different damage values depending on the server performance. Now it's always the same.

[*] Fixed the bug where you would lose famepoints during events

[*] Fix for item/event duplication bug

[*] Fixed quad scale
[/list]

[b]QoL additions[/b]

[list]
[*] Finished adding aging/degradation/wear to all clothing items.

[*] Lowered heat effects of candle and torch items

[*] Searching a puppet now drops items near the prisoner that did the searching instead the puppets position on the server.

[*] Items transfer heat slower if they are contained within clothing items (clothes, backpacks ...)

[*] Items no longer reach cooking temperatures while in clothes or hands.

[*] Cooking meat on skewers working now as expected

[*] Killing a prisoner via a headshot by a high powered rifle will result in his head exploding. (If we don't get videos from this in the first week we are removing it...it's a joke, but really get us some headplosion videos)

[*] Added 10 new tracks to the radio station

[*] Changed number of required days to unlock the survival achievements. Now its: 1, 2, 4, 8, 16, 24 and 32 days.

[*] Reduced chance for rain. (We got too many rainy days here at the office so at least we can get you some rays of sunshine!)

[*] Lowest shadow settings removed from options

[*]  Resolved the issue where meat would continue sizzling after being eaten

[*] Resized the quad a bit so it doesn't look like a toy quad anymore
[/list]

[b]Optimizations[/b]

[list]
[*] Wetness system has been updated, wetness calculation is now much faster. 

[*] Penis optimization. The D had a mind of its own, but we've managed to tame the beast. Don't ask what this means, just trust that we know what's best for you. 

[*] Optimized weather controller on client side. (We are giving your CPU a little breather). It should result in better client performance = more FPS. 

[*] Different dedicated server optimisations. It should result in better server performance = less lag. 
[/list]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27012442/412f6bba3c591ee333ab192641927acf33aa0242.png[/img]

[b]Check taste[/b]

[list]
[*] We added a new option in cooking so you can check in what state is the chicken that you're roasting over the fire. 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27012442/0917915fa0dbcfb29cf61878301438306e2299af.jpg[/img]
[/list]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27012442/412f6bba3c591ee333ab192641927acf33aa0242.png[/img]

Okay, I have to admit that I was blown away by all the awesome screenshots you guys provided. So, I'm doing a new showcase with 5 screenshots. (This is just a small showcase, we will come back later with a bigger one that has more pictures and videos)

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27012442/d7a503d3c508318c2710a4619dec1d2a65530fe4.jpg[/img]

[*] So ignoring the FPS issues that showed up in the last patch (we're already on a good track to resolve the problem), once our new inventory system is live, we will see a performance boost, as we will have a new way to handle items. By that we mean all items: food cans, clothing, cars, weapons etc.
[/list]

[b]Sound[/b]
[list]
[*] Improving reverbation audio system.

[*] Recording and implementing voiceovers for tutorials.

[*] Sound design for badass .50cal sniper.

[*] Investigating how to implement advanced sound propagation.
[/list]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27012442/412f6bba3c591ee333ab192641927acf33aa0242.png[/img]

So, now to the Q&A. We took 10 questions from our last post and answered them here!

[list]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27012442/9458c4b1320b9294fd6061c2910b0beab9d483b9.jpg[/img]
[*] All vehicles will count to the limit of 32 vehicles on the island. 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27012442/9f022d94f592c744982c1e6cb03b7a375ac8e113.jpg[/img]
[*] Steam tends to mess up downloads, verifying game files helps most time.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27012442/0a692e3d689880aec3fd82d74a81fd4d23502540.jpg[/img]
[*] Fair enough, we will fire him, our creative director, and the whole QA team.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27012442/c056e03cc8482de6b874c6be7c676dc6d37a0b71.jpg[/img]
[*]We can count at least 100 small things that we can add to the game to make it interesting, and we will. However, if you miss to fill the holes in the foundation at one point the whole building will come down crashing. Also, feel free to send us those 50 suggestions!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27012442/6e40c938d390c2ab7a67720dfc347f618ec4df89.jpg[/img]
[*] Fun fact, the katana is in the game from day 1.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27012442/8b4405bce2b99140f42492a2e01dada742f3897a.jpg[/img]
[*] The FPS issue is being investigated and as soon as we find the cause we will do our best to fix it, and push a hotfix. The massive FPS drops that have been happening since the patch were not present before, so we are sure we will find the solution to it.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27012442/dffcd9c9a5deb457499aaf17ab6928d0f6407a13.jpg[/img]
[*] The item stacking will come when the whole inventory rework will be live. 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27012442/e0215b5917a078c11023f9ef71030490ea733820.jpg[/img]
[*] No.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27012442/d808d7d152f4770e8352f3cac634bd72bb16dbbe.jpg[/img]
[*] Underwater exploring will be added, with diving equipment more aquatic life and underwater caves to explore!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27012442/361c18583ccd53c42d98da1c744bcd599376ed5e.jpg[/img]
[*] I mean, we are cool with it if you are?
[/list]

That's all for today folks! If you have a question you want covered in the next post, leave it down below!

Love, Josef B Sipster

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27012442/412f6bba3c591ee333ab192641927acf33aa0242.png[/img]

notes.title: Patch Notes 0.1.34.13189 & SCUM comic #8
notes.notes:
Hey, everyone, nice to see you all again! Hope you had a fun week and you're ready for a fun weekend! Let's get into the [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=JCnH65KhA_g]noootes.[/url]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27012442/412f6bba3c591ee333ab192641927acf33aa0242.png[/img]

[b]Observatory[/b]

[list]
[*]As you saw in our previous [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/513710/announcements/detail/1648790886603351811]development post[/url] we have a cool new location!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27012442/5481fe4359db62633556bf6bf5b3e1c7b1f6d289.jpg[/img]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27012442/ecc394186579b430685e1ea78425844de23daa3f.jpg[/img]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27012442/2e63fe6dfd035eef6d504d50a259eeef2a2c05c5.jpg[/img]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27012442/3102734866bf22b21065168c84bea8e67925c4f0.jpg[/img]
[/list]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27012442/412f6bba3c591ee333ab192641927acf33aa0242.png[/img]

[b]A primal Event[/b]

[list]
[*]Guess what! We added a lot of new bows and our arsenal of improvised weapons got bigger, so it was only right for us to make an event specifically for that! Let the best hunter win!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27012442/e217d33342af3a03505d529863de8aad59487b4a.jpg[/img]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27012442/2e2b3ed3fb2b0ac935708c467595452eefedda51.jpg[/img]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27012442/c6185797f349a1abc9cf0b55db062ccc7fe67c0b.jpg[/img]
[/list]

[i]One more thing: Regarding all events we've increased the amount of fame points gained throughout the whole event, so wins in events will be a bit more impactful.[/i]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27012442/412f6bba3c591ee333ab192641927acf33aa0242.png[/img]

[b]Quad Bike![/b]

[list]
[*] FINALLY! A NEW VEHICLE! Here's what you need to know about the quad:

[list]
[*] It seats up to 2 people.

[*] It's slower than the SUV.

[*] It's adjusted for off-road driving.

[*] Has less storage space than the SUV
[/list]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27012442/d7d0d84966fca986cf3727f808733ae62b820344.jpg[/img]
[/list]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27012442/412f6bba3c591ee333ab192641927acf33aa0242.png[/img]

[b]Cooking Rework[/b]

[list]
[*] In this patch you may notice the first of many changes to come in regards to the new cooking system.
In previous patches we've introduced the ability to fuel crafted campfires, and now you'll be able to estimate how strong the fire is and how long it will keep burning just by looking at it. This is also reflected by the fire's temperature.
This is important because now the food items have a proper cooking temperature they should be cooked at.
Items now start to cook when their temperature reaches a certain value (dependant on the item), but if that temperature is too high, it will result in it being overcooked.
If the item is emitting black smoke it should be taken away from the heat. Also keep in mind that the food will continue to cook for some time after being removed from heat, because of the heat it already absorbed.

Pro tip: for best cooking temperature, wait for the fire to subside, and cook on the embers. Also fire does damage now, so don't stand in it.

[b]Currently we are experimenting with visual feedback on how to know when the cooking is done, and things will change as we tune the cooking mechanics![/b]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27012442/1f54252629c79cc595e06fa6a3c8a353288409bd.jpg[/img]
[/list]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27012442/412f6bba3c591ee333ab192641927acf33aa0242.png[/img]

[b]Item Degradation[/b]

[list]
[*] We are adding visual degradation so you can keep track of your items, this feature will be mostly used in cooking, and you'll see the effect on some items beyond cooking. As we improve it more items will be affected by it.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27012442/a86a8b311567e523668c1487848565e906fb43ee.jpg[/img]
[/list]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27012442/412f6bba3c591ee333ab192641927acf33aa0242.png[/img]

[b]New Achievements.[/b]

[list]
[*] We added 7 new achievements that are connected to surviving days on the island.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27012442/bc96454e069d8e6ec35d0e6946f27cff8ea6f4ea.jpg[/img]
[/list]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27012442/412f6bba3c591ee333ab192641927acf33aa0242.png[/img]

[b]Bug fixes[/b]

[list]
[*] Fixed Sanitarium surroundings.

[*] Fixed wind direction and speed in multiplayer

[list]
[*]We noticed that it acted broken in certain situations. Now pay more attention to it when you make long range shoots as it will be a bit harder.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27012442/52cd496aa8ece77db752876056b0ee6ee0c5584c.jpg[/img]
[/list]

[*] Fixed bug when taking compound bow in hands while standing on it would make you fly. (This was awesome and I'm sad its gone)

[*] Fixed crash when items get dragged.

[*] #SetTime command didn't work in SP now it works.
[/list]

[b]QoL Additions[/b]

[list]
[*] The golden drone now has speed that matches player movements (inside and outside vehicles). That makes following the player easier.

[*] Claimed doors without locks can be reclaimed now.

[*] Prohibited lockpicking while having negative fame points
[/list]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27012442/412f6bba3c591ee333ab192641927acf33aa0242.png[/img]

Comic time! Everyone say thank you to Ivona for her awesome work, and if you missed them, here are the previous issues.

[*] [url=https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27012442/73fd2832e9f3cccb7dc320564cb3a81b66bc005e.jpg]Comic page #5[/url]

notes.title: Development update #5
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27012442/50c64eefb6a8851452a944d2fdd71cb87912c430.jpg[/img]

Hey everyone, we heard you missed our development updates, so we brought you one straight from Gamepires' kitchen. Read up on what we're cooking down below!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27012442/412f6bba3c591ee333ab192641927acf33aa0242.png[/img]

[b]Base Building[/b]

[list]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27012442/9a3affe9d6d72142eea55d38e447a2450b9a26c2.jpg[/img]

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=0-33lvpOz2U&feature=youtu.be

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=sFCCXRQV_OA&feature=youtu.be
[/list]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27012442/412f6bba3c591ee333ab192641927acf33aa0242.png[/img]

[b]Paddling[/b]

[list]
[*] We showed you some of the animations that we will use on boats, but we will have simple water transportation methods as well. 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27012442/c42ce1fea1a7a5aaa5cd8942c46d6c0fdcfd2254.jpg[/img]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27012442/0127f2a6bcd26b983ffd5a631979c7ec51936e94.jpg[/img]
[/list]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27012442/412f6bba3c591ee333ab192641927acf33aa0242.png[/img]

[b]Quad Bike[/b]

[list]
[*] Regarding transport, we are adding a quad bike. The quad will be able to seat 2 people,it has a storage box, and will come in different versions.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27012442/746fef8d0d38cc6e19cc0c72588095d802e4c4a9.jpg[/img]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27012442/6f0ea235ce757daf098f66df78299e5b3c00d3cf.jpg[/img]
[/list]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27012442/412f6bba3c591ee333ab192641927acf33aa0242.png[/img]

[b]Driving skill[/b]

[*] If you would hit the car engine it will do more damage than if you would hit the side of the car.

[*] Shooting tires can result that the car will stop driving.
[/list]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27012442/412f6bba3c591ee333ab192641927acf33aa0242.png[/img]

[b]City buildings[/b]

[list]
[*] We are still not sure when the first city will come to the island, but we are making good progress on the assets.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27012442/00efa15e191f720bdf0049f79a9b82d5c09f2e99.jpg[/img]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27012442/d0e650e15c4574b67d8a57b487e57e85c7966cf3.jpg[/img]
[/list]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27012442/412f6bba3c591ee333ab192641927acf33aa0242.png[/img]

[b]Observatory[/b]

[list]
[*] New place to explore! Want to gaze some stars? 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27012442/ecc394186579b430685e1ea78425844de23daa3f.jpg[/img]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27012442/3102734866bf22b21065168c84bea8e67925c4f0.jpg[/img]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27012442/2e63fe6dfd035eef6d504d50a259eeef2a2c05c5.jpg[/img]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27012442/5481fe4359db62633556bf6bf5b3e1c7b1f6d289.jpg[/img]
[/list]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27012442/412f6bba3c591ee333ab192641927acf33aa0242.png[/img]

[b]Surprise![/b]

[list]
[*] This one doesn't need an introduction.

[spoiler][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27012442/b37187984f578d4e536477c4bf143d15adc339b1.jpg[/img][/spoiler]
[/list]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27012442/412f6bba3c591ee333ab192641927acf33aa0242.png[/img]

[b]Missions[/b]

[list]
[*] Okay we know a lot of people have been waiting for this. That's the reason we are taking our time to deliver it in the best condition possible. This is how it looks for now.

[*] For missions we are adding a new tab called "Journal" that's the place where you will track all your quests.

[*] For now there will be 3 mission types: Main story, Side story and Tutorial. There will be few ways of getting/triggering a mission:
[olist]
   
    [*] Getting to a certain location
    [*] Over the Journal 
    [*] Meeting certain conditions (crafting, skill level etc..)
    [*] Team missions (Team leader distributes roles and assignments for 
         missions)
[/olist]

[*] In some mission more people will be able to partake, but only the one who finishes first will get the reward. The same works with teams.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27012442/932266c56040e50ae58905cbecac5711ce2e3102.jpg[/img]
[/list]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27012442/412f6bba3c591ee333ab192641927acf33aa0242.png[/img]

[b]Inventory Rework[/b]

[list]
[*] To those unaware, inventory rework is well underway.
What that brings is a more flexible and performant system which will allow us to more easily implement specific inventory and item-related features.
Features you can expect in the first wave include support for stacking various items, rotating items in your inventory, as well as improved chests / car inventory handling with accompanying UI.
What it will also enable us to do includes, for example, lowering your pants when doing #2, attaching various items to your backpack and such QoL things.
[/list]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27012442/412f6bba3c591ee333ab192641927acf33aa0242.png[/img]

[b]Cooking[/b]

[list]
[*] Basic level of cooking should be soon over, to get the grip of how it works we need to cover a few things first.

[*] We reworked how fire works, as the fire consumes the wood its temperature will drop over time (now it will have an visual effect for easier fire tracking).

[*] Similar system is the drying system. The closer you are to the fire the bigger the heat and the faster the food cooks. So things that will impact the final cooking product are:
[olist]
    [*]Fire strength 
    [*]Food distance from fire
    [*]Type of food (Some dishes are faster done some slower)
    [*]How fast the food item absorbs heat
[/olist]
Also, try not to burn the bacon as its possible to burn food if the fire is too strong and the food is too close to it.
[/list]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27012442/412f6bba3c591ee333ab192641927acf33aa0242.png[/img]

[b]Language support[/b]

[list]
[*] We updated German, Russian and Simplified Chinese.

[*] We are adding more languages:
[list]
    [*]French
    [*]Spanish
    [*]Portuguese
    [*]Traditional Chinese
[/list]
[/list]

notes.title: Patch Notes 0.1.33.12968
notes.notes:

Hello you beautiful people, here we are once again with some new additions!

[b]But before we get into the notes we just want to announce that with this patch we will wipe everything besides the things you have on your character. Due new features and mechanics that we will add through time.[/b]

As you know last week we were away so this wont be the biggest patch we delivered, but lets get into what will [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=RaCodgL9cvk]drop[/url]!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27012442/061503b236f3b3070a8061b2c1b8baa4f40f7c62.png[/img]

[b]Achievements[/b]

[list]
[*] Boom goes the dynamite, here they are. Some new challenges to aspire, and make sure we will add more of them as time passes! For now, we will just share the icons, and we will leave the rest for you guys to wonder!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27012442/94a2ba3dfd72495bae97694c126ce3f50135fa97.png[/img]
 [/list]

[b]MK-18[/b]

[list]
[*] The new rifle MK-18 is a fully automatic rifle with single, and fully automatic firing mode that uses a M16 clip filled with 5.56x24mm cartridge. It has a built in rail so you can attach sights and scopes without a rail, and it can be found in military areas.

notes.title: Patch Notes 0.1.31.12780 and SCUM comic #5
notes.notes:
Hey, everyone!

It's your fave devs bringing you a [b]brand new update[/b] and a [b]brand new comic page[/b]! You already got a [b]hotfix[/b] this past week, as well as several blog posts, so the next person who tries to spin the story into anything other than us working like crazy gets [url=https://twitter.com/Gamepires/status/1114066771433148418]the same treatment our Goran got this morning[/url].

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27012442/061503b236f3b3070a8061b2c1b8baa4f40f7c62.png[/img]

[b]Driving skill[/b]

[b]WE HAVE FULLY IMPLEMENTED THE DRIVING SKILL, YAY!!![/b]
This is how it works now:

[list]
[*] All existing characters will have No Skill level by default.

[*] Driving skill affects: time it takes to turn on the engine, chance for engine stutter when trying to drive vehicle from rest, chance for engine stutter when shifting to higher gear, chance for engine to turn off after stutter, top speed, time it takes to change gears and ability to steer properly.

[*] As you level up your skill the chance of car problems gets lower.

[*] Also we updated car sounds to better sounding versions.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27012442/f21f9608d61aba5e550efe284df7aa9f37c42026.jpg[/img]
[/list]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27012442/061503b236f3b3070a8061b2c1b8baa4f40f7c62.png[/img]

[b]Radio[/b]

[list]
[*] Our radio is finally done! Now you will be able to find it in 2 ways. One is to find a radio in the world and carry it around, the other way is to find a car because each car has its own radio. The radios scattered around the world sound as crappy as you would expect them to sound. The car radio sounds as good as you would expect it to sound. Realism, friends!

[*] Car radio controls:
J - Turn on/off radio
Ctrl + J   - volume down
Shift + J - volume up 

[*] For now you will hear some promos for our events, and have different types of cool music to listen to. These are still mostly placeholders because we have some cool plans for it in the future. 

[b]If you are a musician who would like to have your music in the game, or you have a small underground indie band you would like to support this way, please send an email to tena at gamepires dot com for more info![/b]

[*] [b]Guess who your radio host is! That's right, it's our John Dick, who else would it be?[/b]

We did a small rework on how loot spawns, so now abundant loot is abundant and rare loot is rare, most of the abundant loot can be used for crafting to get better gear. In all we are trying to expand the time you need to get high end gear, but also to make ti feel more rewarding.

[list]
[*] We found the fix for chests in rocks, but if we add it now every chest that is in a rock won't be accessible.

So we are giving you time until the next patch to get all your lot from those chests to a safe place, as from the next patch you wont be able to place chests in rocks or access them.

[b]Bug fixes[/b]

[list]
[*] Fixed a bug where a chest without durability couldn't be destroyed.

[*] Fixed a bug regarding item spawning that caused possible server crashes.

[*] Fixed a bug where backpacks were clipped to the chest while climbing ladders. We also introduced the bug where in the first person view the camera is a bit offset while climbing ladders, but hey, we're working on it!

[*] Fixed a bug where if you had a quiver equipped, after relogging the quiver would drop to the ground.

[*] Fixed a bug when a player was killed its ragdoll would pop around. 
[/list]

notes.title: Patch Notes 0.1.29.12610 and SCUM comic #4
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27012442/980abb9db4c9800c40866b02b522caf00564774a.jpg[/img]

Hello our lovely #scummunity, oh boy do we have a nice little surprise for you all. It starts with an A and ends with "[url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vncIBREXCwU]rrow in the knee[/url]" (And no, 2012 is not calling for their joke back). 

Jokes aside, the time has finally come to welcome the [b]archery skill[/b] to the SCUM family, and we're eager to show you what we have for you!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27012442/2a02f150dbc0051e042fe733d5b08904942cf74f.png[/img]

[h1]Archery[/h1]

[list]
[*]Archery is a skill of shooting from bows. There are different types of bows players will be using in the game. Depending on the type, bows are divided into: recurves (one piece bow), takedowns (limbs can be changed and removed, when disassembled it can fit in the backpack), compounds and crossbows. Because crossbows perform more like rifles they will be handled separately.

[*]All bows also have different poundage. The poundage (it's common to use the pound sign – # – to indicate pounds, so 40 pounds would be represented as 40#), or draw weight represents the force required to hold the string stationary at full draw. Draw weight is used to define the power of the bow.  For pulling the bow string player uses both strength and technique. While strength is related to his attribute, technique is related to his skill.

For now we have 3 types of bows: Compound bow, Improvised bow, and Recurve bow.

[b]Compound Bow[/b]

[list]
[*] The compound bow will have a draw weight of 60#, you can attach to it sights, stabilizers , and the silencer.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27012442/92425c19039d7a91a3c1fef7d6ee4496d11b3a18.jpg[/img]
[/list]

[b]Improvised Bow[/b]

[list]
[*] The improvised bow is the most basic bow in the game, you can craft 4 versions of it with different draw weights: 20#, 25#, 30#, 35#. You can attach the silencer to it.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27012442/9e32a95dfbe1ae7a7c53eff798163f76d1f9486e.jpg[/img]
[/list]

[b]Recurve Bow[/b]

[list]
[*] The recurve bow is the middle ground when it comes to bows, it has most versions of draw weight: 40#/50#/60#/70#/80#/90#/100# and you can attach the silencer on it.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27012442/f43ea09e52ba207fc4258bce1e30d20832a20635.jpg[/img]
[/list]


[*]If the player doesn’t have sufficient strength or skill he/she will not be able to pull the string all the way. In the following table you can see how strength relates with specific draw weight.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27012442/856952b79c74c9cf2c7433e1fe5a8dd8613b5dd9.jpg[/img]

[*]Archery skill level influences both how long player can hold the bow steady in full draw and gives additional bonuses. Here is a bonus that archery skill gives to player’s strength. 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27012442/88ec5a5e43bb00e31f90e16127461db49a63e2ec.jpg[/img]

[*]The initial time for holding the bow steady in the full draw is shown in the table below.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27012442/12071f6bd91a479c37a31cdb4fb5e3ca4920b5ab.jpg[/img]

[*]If character’s Strength DW + Skill DW > Bow’s Poundage (DW) then character will be able to draw that bow in full draw position, but if his strength is below the value of strength that can hold that bow steady, he will get penalties. For each 10# over what player’s strength can handle, player will get -1 second penalty to hold that bow steadily. That parameter is not fixed and it should change along with player’s strength (meaning that it can have a decimal value). For each 10# less than what player’s strength can handle player will get +1 second bonus.

[b]Example 1[/b] - Let’s say the player has Archery skill level [b]ADV+[/b] and [b]STR 5[/b] he can hold [b]100#[/b] in full draw for [b]8[/b] seconds ([b]10 – 2[/b] seconds penalty because of his strength can hold 80# bow and he is trying 100# bow).

[b]Example 2[/b] - Let’s say the player has Archery skill level [b]ADV[/b] and [b]STR 3[/b] he can’t hold [b]100#[/b] in full draw, but he can hold [b]80#[/b] for [b]3[/b] seconds ([b]6 – 3[/b] seconds penalty because of his strength can hold 50# bow and he is trying 80# bow).

[b]Example 3[/b] - Let’s say the player has Archery skill level [b]Basic[/b] and [b]STR 5[/b] he can’t hold [b]100#[/b] in full draw, but he can hold [b]80#[/b] for [b]5[/b] seconds ([b]4 seconds[/b] because of Basic skill level [b]+1 second[/b] bonus because sum of his strength and Skill bonus is 90# which by 10# > than 80#).

[*] We are adding quivers as well, and here is how they will work. There will be 3 types of quivers: Improvised quiver, Animal skin quiver and Military quiver

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27012442/bafd75ec8b8be0b860c561c7f16d22faed98327a.jpg[/img]

[b]Improvised Quiver:[/b] Can hold up to 1 type of arrow, and durability is low.

[b]Animal Skin Quiver:[/b] Can hold up to 2 types of arrow, medium durability.

[b]Military Quiver:[/b] Can hold up to 3 types of arrow, highly durable.

If you have a quiver equipped and pick up an arrow it first goes into the quiver and if the quiver is full it will go into the next empty space slot if possible. 

You can also carry a quiver and backpack together.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27012442/5727a5ea4b2ea59680b5728202ed736ac96eca3c.jpg[/img]

[*] There will be various attachments that you will be able to put on your bow. For now we have: sights, stabilizers and a silencer.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27012442/72a72087aaeea00cfeca96f53ed86107fb657fbd.jpg[/img]

[b]Stabilizers[/b] will help you out in stabilizing your bow and calm your hand so the arrow spread is much smaller, there are 2 stabilizers, a professional one and an improvised one.

[b]Sights[/b] will help you to zero in better on your target - there are 3 sights with the same quality, but different amount of zeroing points. The one pin sight is attached by default on the compound bow.

[b]Silencer[/b] will mask down the snapping sound that the bow makes once it's released and the string collides with the bow limbs. For now there is only 1 type of silencer that you can find.
[/list]

[b]Please keep in mind this is the first iteration of the archery skill and bugs and issues are possible to happen, if you encounter any please do send us a bug report on our steam forums![/b]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27012442/2a02f150dbc0051e042fe733d5b08904942cf74f.png[/img]

[b]Red dot[/b]

[list]
[*] The classic attachment used on various guns. You can attach it to any rail, and the M16, TEC01 490 can carry it without any rail.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27012442/a988de7305c3addf21451eb40952275ca509d002.jpg[/img]
[/list]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27012442/2a02f150dbc0051e042fe733d5b08904942cf74f.png[/img]

[b]Fire modes[/b]

[list]
[*]YES WE HEARD YOU, LIKE, REALLY WELL, THE FIRST 12967198264783 TIMES, but yeah we should have added this a bit sooner, but you know how it is in gamedev. All in all, now you can see in what fire mode you are on each weapon through the quick access bar.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27012442/1ab24233a64b839194080a0ac52b356798002837.jpg[/img]
[/list]


[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27012442/2a02f150dbc0051e042fe733d5b08904942cf74f.png[/img]

[b]Damage Indicator.[/b]
[list]
[*]We added a small damage indicator that will appear when you need patching.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27012442/b4909e882e2ae9cf41941f5fae9996b4f0de4989.jpg[/img]
[/list]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27012442/2a02f150dbc0051e042fe733d5b08904942cf74f.png[/img]

[b]Respawn Timers[/b]

[list]
[*] A big issue was when squads were repsawning for an infinite amount of time, so we added respawn timers this is how they will work.

[b]Random respawn:[/b] 25 FP and has no respawn timer or cooldown.

[b]Sector respawn:[/b] 50 FP with an initial cooldown of 15 seconds and increases for 15 seconds for each consecutive use. Time needed for the cooldown to get back to 15 seconds is 60 seconds of wait time, and each time you use it, those 60 seconds get multiplied by 1.25 that way the cooldown reset time will never be lower than the respawn timer itself.

[b]Shelter respawn:[/b] 75 FP with an initial cooldown of 30 seconds and increases for 30 seconds for each consecutive use. Time needed for the cooldown to get back to 30 seconds is 120 seconds of wait time, and each time you use it those 120 seconds get multiplied by 1.5.

[b]Squad respawn:[/b] 100 FP with an initial cooldown of 60 seconds and increases for 60 seconds for each consecutive use. Time needed for the cooldown to get back to 60 seconds is 180 seconds of wait time, and each time you use it, those 180 seconds get multiplied by 2.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27012442/a173fdcc91c76c261a0003d2f73d6d827823fbc3.jpg[/img]
[/list]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27012442/2a02f150dbc0051e042fe733d5b08904942cf74f.png[/img]

[b]Underwater caves[/b]

[list]
[*] Who doesn't love some underwater exploring? 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27012442/3595fd1cf108611d443dc34544857c5d22d8d701.jpg[/img]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27012442/e6a3d2096c25a2eae0d7fa8f4d16c13da1c384fc.jpg[/img]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27012442/74f20e33a48e8b65c26de6452dd70105a8ff154e.jpg[/img]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27012442/8e41fb3c4a22beee48a80d237f04e5fb4e0e69fc.jpg[/img]
[/list]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27012442/2a02f150dbc0051e042fe733d5b08904942cf74f.png[/img]

[b]Fashion[/b]

[list]
[*] Just as a small fashion update we added a new line of beanies.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27012442/035a737b8cc2867d3929867257aca8bb923506f9.jpg[/img]
[/list]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27012442/2a02f150dbc0051e042fe733d5b08904942cf74f.png[/img]

[b]Supporter Pack Update[/b]

[list]
[*] We added a new action that all the supporters can use, and that's whistling. If you use it to coordinate military ops, or just want to tell that cute guy that you like him, all up to you!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27012442/3b727ef881856d9b2d6bac89505942f752af4012.jpg[/img]
[/list]

[b]Bug smashing[/b]

[list]
[*] Fixed the bug with doors staying closed.

[*] Fixed a bug with clients crashing if admin drone was active on server.

[*] Possible fix for wrong kind of respawning while entering or exiting events.

[*] Fixed underwater fog bug when resolution scale is not 100.

[*] Fixed heat sources being shared between singleplayer profiles.
[/list]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27012442/2a02f150dbc0051e042fe733d5b08904942cf74f.png[/img]

[b]QoL additions[/b]

[list]
[*] Respawn on squad now disabled if all members are dead or if any squadmate is in combat.

[*] Failing lockpicking will correctly give a small amount of experience now.

[*] Failing lockpicking will cause a loss of 1 fame point.

[*] Lowered Spawn rate on Cargo drops. (Once per hour with an 10min before notification)

[*] Added engine sound to admin drone. Gets turned off when entering silent mode.
[/list]

[b]Admin commands[/b]

[list]
[*] We added admin commands for the new respawn system, events and cargo drops.

[SCUM.RespawnSettings]

RandomLocationPrice - Fame Points required for respawning at random location

SectorLocationPrice - Fame Points required for respawning at a certain sector

ShelterLocationPrice - Fame Points required for respawning at shelter

SquadLocationPrice - Fame Points required for respawning at squadmate

RandomInitialTime - Initial wait time before 'Random' respawn option becomes available

SectorInitialTime - Initial wait time before 'Sector' respawn option becomes available

ShelterInitialTime - Initial wait time before 'Shelter' respawn option becomes available

SquadInitialTime - Initial wait time before 'Squadmate' respawn option becomes available

RandomCooldownTime - Penalty wait time applied to 'Random' respawn option after each use

SectorCooldownTime - Penalty wait time  applied to 'Sector' respawn option after each use

ShelterCooldownTime - Penalty wait time  applied to 'Shelter' respawn option after each use

SquadCooldownTime - Penalty wait time  applied to 'Squadmate' option after each use

RandomCooldownResetMultiplier - Amount of time required for the penalty to reset for 'Random' respawn option

SectorCooldownResetMultiplier - Amount of time required for the penalty to reset for 'Sector' respawn option

ShelterCooldownResetMultiplier - Amount of time required for the penalty to reset for 'Shelter' respawn option

SquadCooldownResetMultiplier - Amount of time required for the penalty to reset for 'Squadmate' respawn option

[SCUM.WorldEvents]

TimeBetweenEventsMin - Minimum time between each world event

TimeBetweenEventsMax - Maximum time between each world event

CargoDropFallDelay - Delay between the cargo drop notification and it actually appearing

CargoDropFallDuration - Amount of time the cargo drops spend falling

CargoDropSelfDestructTime - Amount of time before the cargo drop self-destruct countdown is initiated after it lands
[/list]


[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27012442/2a02f150dbc0051e042fe733d5b08904942cf74f.png[/img]

[b]Known issue[/b]
[list]
[*] TEC01 490 shotguns down the sight aim is slightly off, we will fix it as fast as possible.
[/list]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27012442/2a02f150dbc0051e042fe733d5b08904942cf74f.png[/img]

You brave souls who stuck through the whole patch notes, here is a little treat for you our #4 comic page! Just in case you missed the previous ones check them out here:

[url=https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27012442/b4fbd2c387b0766ff797fa0b1c0a35728bf9f568.jpg]Page #1[/url]
[url=https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27012442/19c3cdf64dafe8e7548bb2c5112327ad54d8ae8d.jpg]Page #2[/url]
[url=https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27012442/d8daea2c21933e3d9b26d2d92cb6e98ad6a9977c.jpg]Page #3[/url]

And our newest addition!

[url=https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27012442/0fef7c2a9d3e1a6ff318f811724b925c367020a9.jpg][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27012442/0fef7c2a9d3e1a6ff318f811724b925c367020a9.jpg[/img][/url]

That's it for today, folks!

Love, Sippycup Punanisnatch

[url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=JCnH65KhA_g]Byeeeee[/url]

notes.title: Development Update #3
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27012442/f2a226bb68d92e2c0586df9ef9a46f05d8bbaaa1.jpg[/img]

Ladies and gentlemen, welcome to our new presentation of features and mechanics that we plan to introduce into our video game over an unknown course of time, and this is the last time I'm constructing this vast visual field of information after a pleasant tea party with an eloquent 8-year-old.

So, shall we begin?

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27012442/2a02f150dbc0051e042fe733d5b08904942cf74f.png[/img]

A new interesting POI that will be a nice event place to duke it out, and an overall simple but interesting location. This is just 1 building, and you can expect more of those.

[list]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27012442/2edc18c1116e2da5dee2d4060648ed01b7903197.jpg[/img]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27012442/c32c27bca2523cad9c562aa7296bf81a315cfc0e.jpg[/img]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27012442/e925721a274deb80133dd5c349e6942470830cb3.jpg[/img]
[/list]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27012442/2a02f150dbc0051e042fe733d5b08904942cf74f.png[/img]

[b]New additions to the weapon family.[/b]



MK-18 will be a fully automatic rifle with single and burst fire modes as well. The mag it uses is from the M16 and 5.56 cal ammo.

[list]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27012442/3641333ba048f5c81fa241d58feb654d29eea9d0.jpg[/img]

[/list]

The RPG doesn't need any introduction, load, aim, pew. 

[list]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27012442/173cfd6ee06f499583b5f1352552704bd1399168.jpg[/img]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27012442/867dbe4bd7b93f22044b7a9c18b5b7d77e644682.jpg[/img]
[/list]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27012442/2a02f150dbc0051e042fe733d5b08904942cf74f.png[/img]

Water collector, the idea is when it rains it collects water, what a shocker. 

[list]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27012442/d19dbceffcd58d5342e2bc7fc1bee52e1461f997.jpg[/img]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27012442/39afe46344523583f819eb81c4decda32878129a.jpg[/img]
[/list]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27012442/2a02f150dbc0051e042fe733d5b08904942cf74f.png[/img]

[b]Hair growth.[/b]

Hair is coming along nicely, we are looking at several hair and beard styles once its done.

[list]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27012442/35dc552eb5dbc185d549a4438b18929df31ef9fb.jpg[/img]
[/list]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27012442/2a02f150dbc0051e042fe733d5b08904942cf74f.png[/img]

[b]Archery[/b]

Yup, the archery skill is finally here, and boy oh boy do we have all sorts of awesome mechanics here. But that one I will cover in the next patch notes and for now have these few snippets scratched off the surface.

[list]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27012442/2ef8b09d878a50f5cd46f5e66cc7eb484496828d.jpg[/img]

[/list]

And this is it for today folks thanks for dropping by, and stay tuned for more news!

Love u, Sippy Seep Sipp

notes.title: Development Update #2
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27012442/a6682769b23f57685fe107eac4b346f3d025a770.jpg[/img]

[h1]Another Monday, another update from us, so you guys can be in the loop of what's cooking in the Gamepires' [url=http://prntscr.com/mzeaad]crocpot.[/url][/h1]


[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27012442/bbbb7395fadc918312cd8fccca6efa992c9b7c47.png[/img]

We have lots of new things coming up over the next few weeks. Let's talk about some of them down below!

[h1]Female characters[/h1]

[h1]Bases.[/h1]

[list]
[*] We've made some progress with the bases regarding building and shaping them up to be a home sweet home.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27012442/bfd372cb982abf43d6c45097014abd8ae877f89d.jpg[/img]

[*] But keep in mind that base building won't replace fortifications. Fortifications will still be the main way to secure a building and the base building will be a way to enhance and double protect your fortified building with different types of walls and watchtowers.

[h1]Hair[/h1]

[list]
[*] Yes, yes we know, it's not cool that everyone is bald all the time, so here's some neat cuts that will make all the puppets go crazy for you, stud.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27012442/f0b94399e707179e4e4c8dc1c90d175041767b92.jpg[/img]

Okay, I'm all out of pictures for the art part, but I still have things that we can talk about!

[h1]Sound[/h1]

[list]
[*] Right now we are working on redesigning the car sounds and adding the suppressed weapon fire. We're also working hard on getting back the radio we had before. For now, it looks good, and who knows, besides awesome music maybe you will hear something intriguing.
[/list]

[h1]New points of interest.[/h1]

[list]
[*] As you already know, we've recently added some 20ish new islands around the main island, so now we're working on the underwater caverns to go with our maritime theme. However, before we add that to the game, we still need to finish up the sailing and diving skill. 
[/list]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27012442/bbbb7395fadc918312cd8fccca6efa992c9b7c47.png[/img]

Now it's time to talk about the programming background and what's going on there.

[h1]Base building[/h1]

[list]
[*] Let's talk about the base building first - the system will work in a way that you'll be able to use blueprints and build up your base in a lego style way.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27012442/c8c8219d174b6dadfd71101bfff7d6d6e38b107d.jpg[/img]
[i]Each beer crate is 1 base segment, and you will be able to stack them to your liking.[/i]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27012442/ef2b0ce822e9aad878b0dec33f54d6e6b574177f.jpg[/img]
[i]For safety, we emptied all crates[/i] 
[/list]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27012442/bbbb7395fadc918312cd8fccca6efa992c9b7c47.png[/img]

[h1]Respawn system[/h1]

[list]
[*] For the moment we're still playing around with different options, but for now, this is the plan: adding cooldowns to respawn options that we already have. Cooldowns will differ depending on how precise they are. For now, it would look like the shortest cooldown would have "Random" > "Sector" > "Shelter" > "Squadmate". Also, the idea is to disable respawn on squadmate if he is in combat.
[/list]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27012442/bbbb7395fadc918312cd8fccca6efa992c9b7c47.png[/img]

Thanks for dropping by and reading our little weekly update, stay tuned for more news coming later this week!

Love, Sippy Boy

notes.title: Patch Notes 0.1.28.12280 and SCUM comic #2
notes.notes:
[h1]Hello everyone, here we are with a new hotfix for this week. Those damn doors are tricky! We've fixed most of the bigger bugs with them, but some edge cases may still appear, so thanks for bearing with us and, by all means, do report them if you see them![/h1]

Let's get into the notes!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27012442/03c22d68f41a60d57a4c314392a09b37dee602de.png[/img]

[h1]Birds![/h1]

We're adding two different bird species for you guys to practice your aim on. If you manage to take them down, you might get yourself a nice lunch!

[list]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27012442/738f823029aed041550e06aa1e6f3877a46fa52c.jpg[/img] 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27012442/0fa260f81d3d6aa7f4a44a987cc057587a30471d.jpg[/img]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27012442/f8ada8499dfa8c09d0fccf2955cdabe823010462.jpg[/img]
[/list]

[h1]Lockpicking[/h1]

[b][Community Request][/b] We made lockpicking even harder to pull off and increased the rarity of lockpicks.

[h1]Bug fixes[/h1]

[list]
[*] Fixed character creation where the character disappears during animation.

[*] Fixed the bug where examining an item that isn't craftable wouldn't work.

[*] Fixed the bug where some food items would spawn with 0 durability.

[*] Fixed the bug with windows on airfield where some windows wouldn't be completely covered up with fortifications.

[*] Fixed the bug where double clicking food from the vicinity wouldn't pick it up.

[*] Fixed the bug where food items would be incorrectly considered as cooking, causing weird behavior such as their durability decreasing fast.

[*] Possible fix for syncing initial doors & fortifications state. We're still figuring this out, so make sure to let us know if you run into anything weird.

[*] Fixed an issue where vegetation would penetrate through buildings and fences.

[*] Fixed a bug when you started SP and MP game it would always be night.

[*] Fixed a bug for prisoner not being kicked out of event properly if the player logs out during the event end countdown, resulting in equipment being lost and prisoner rejoining the server naked
[/list]

[h1]QoL changes[/h1]

[list]
[*] [b][Community Request][/b] You can now play as a drone in SP - while in the main menu press Ctrl+D 

[*] [b][Community Request][/b] You can now toggle HUD and lights while playing with the drone. Toggle HUD (H key) toggle lights (X key) 
[/list]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27012442/03c22d68f41a60d57a4c314392a09b37dee602de.png[/img]

[h1]SCUM comic![/h1]

That's it for the patch notes, but wait, that's not all. Down below you can find the 2nd page of our SCUM comic! If you haven't read the first part yet, make sure to check it out [url=https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27012442/b4fbd2c387b0766ff797fa0b1c0a35728bf9f568.jpg]here[/url]. The comic is made by our art queen [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/513710/announcements/detail/1808664240303248866]Ivona[/url] on a weekly basis and will be out every Friday, so make sure to let us know what you think!


[url=https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27012442/19c3cdf64dafe8e7548bb2c5112327ad54d8ae8d.jpg][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27012442/19c3cdf64dafe8e7548bb2c5112327ad54d8ae8d.jpg[/img][/url]

Thanks for sticking around and talk to you soon!

Peace out, Sippycup

[h1]Lockpick rework.[/h1]

We made little changes to lockpicking and how it works. We had a feel it was too easy to break a lock down, so we made it little harder:
[list]
[*] Reduced the angle needed to unlock a door successfully.

[*] The screwdriver has now 40 uses, before you could it use indefinitlley
[list]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27012442/202aa97078eca7cad43c27b6b593a02476319858.jpg[/img]
[/list]

[*] Normal lockpick uses reduced to 4, and added an advance lock pick with 6 uses.
[list]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27012442/0f40cbda7b930e9b1628d6eec57bc7ecfb239b0e.jpg[/img]
[/list]
[/list]

[h1]Server admin commands.[/h1]

We added 3 more commands for you guys so you can customize your server even more.

[list]
[*] AllowSectorRespawn

[*] AllowShelterRespawn

[*] AllowSquadmateRespawn
[/list]

With this you can control how respawning works.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27012442/2a02f150dbc0051e042fe733d5b08904942cf74f.png[/img]

[h1]Bug fixes and other goodies.[/h1]

[list]
[*] Adjusted third person clipping prevention for crouch stance.

[*] Bugfix for players dying when climbing windows.

[*] Fixed placement of fortification blueprints being placed wrong sometimes.

[*] Maximum resolution scale is now 200%

[*] Small improvement for DLSS.

[*] More .ini file restrictions.

[*] More server optimisations by reducing count of replication objects.

[*] Fixed a bug where the player could not level up awareness in multiplayer

[*] Fixed a bug where cargo drop would drop multiple cargo drops.
[/list]

[b]In case you get a problem of connecting to a server, please keep in mind from the moment of the patch deployment that the servers can take up to 60 minutes to update![/b]


Now that the patch notes are out of the way, we have a treat for you!
Down below you will find [b]the first page of our new weekly comic series[/b] that will help you understand SCUM's lore even better! A big thank you to our Ivona - you are a star!

[url=https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27012442/b4fbd2c387b0766ff797fa0b1c0a35728bf9f568.jpg][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27012442/b4fbd2c387b0766ff797fa0b1c0a35728bf9f568.jpg[/img][/url]

That's all for now folks - see you next week!

Love u, Sippy Boy Sipmaster

notes.title: Development update #1
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27012442/4332b591ff82af0f55eb19ec8b83f65291662622.jpg[/img]

[h1]Hello our lovelies, come take a cookie and a cup of tea, relax and listen to what we have to say today![/h1]

Later this week we will have a patch ready for you guys. It's gonna have all sorts of awesome things, from weapons to a new place, and some neat optimizations that we will talk about today.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27012442/2a02f150dbc0051e042fe733d5b08904942cf74f.png[/img]

We're temporarily disabling storing items in anything that is NOT a chest. We found out it takes up a lot of performance and clogs the server up, which can cause many things:

[list]
[*] Random player teleporting.

[*] Random car teleporting.

[*] Falling through the ground, player and vehicle.

[*] Vaulting and respawning issues.

[*] Even more abnormal puppet behaviour.

[*] You missing that sweet headshot that should have hit.
[/list]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27012442/898adff9962545dbb73439ed52761e7c587999ac.jpg[/img]
[i]A few examples of where you won't be able to store items anymore[/i]

We don't plan to remove the storing system, we're working to fix that issue as we speak, and hopefully we'll have it back in no time!

So, what does all that mean?

[list]
[*] A new patch coming soon!

[*] More content!

[*] Removing the storing possibility from non-chest containers.

[*] More optimizations and a better experience for everyone.

[*] [b]If you don't want to lose all your stored items, make sure to put them in a crafted chest or car![/b]
[/list]

That's it for now, thank you for dropping by and we hope you all enjoy this almost springtime! See you soon with some spicy news! 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27012442/2a02f150dbc0051e042fe733d5b08904942cf74f.png[/img]

[*] Adjusted armor calculation and fixed the bug that caused helmets to protect from headshots a bit too well.

[*] Starting lockpicking will now take the screwdriver in hands.

[*] Adjusted the transition between the prone and crouch actions (eating, cutting etc.), so it blends in better, and is not snappy.
[/list]

notes.title: Patch Notes 0.1.25.11684
notes.notes:
Here we are with a new patch, more bug fixes, QoL changes and some extras!

So let's start with some new things that we added.
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27012442/bbbb7395fadc918312cd8fccca6efa992c9b7c47.png[/img]
[h1]Server optimizations[/h1]

[*]So we looked into lag, as no one likes lag. And we did something awesome, items that repeated a lot on the island (doors etc..) we found a way how to lower servers awareness of those items, and we gained a massive boost, up to 5x faster. Down bellow you can check out how the whole process went.

[*]Also we deployed a new master server and that means faster server list browsing!

[spoiler]It was a warm and sunny summer morning last April. I was sitting in my favourite sofa in the office. Thinking about SCUM. And big data. As I always do in the evenings. At one point there are 5 doughnuts on my table, and the first thought that came to me "How to eat all 5 in a most efficient way?" and then it dawned on me. Big. data. blockchain. crypto-algorithms. using cutting edge deep network machine learning methods for network replication IoT applications.
And so I started to mash my keyboard (already on the third keyboard), and then it was born. Network crypto-algorithm replication blockchain.
Everything that was a lot now is lot less and server runs about 5x faster. Fixed the game. The end, or is it?[/spoiler]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27012442/bbbb7395fadc918312cd8fccca6efa992c9b7c47.png[/img]
[h1]New weapons![/h1]
[list]
[*] M1891

We added a new family member to the rifles in SCUM. The M1891, a five-shot, bolt-action rifle. It uses the 7.62x54mmR cartridge, and it can be found in military areas.

[list]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27012442/0c33516a232b2358b92e9e2e1bb60f22e4e3d2d1.jpg[/img]
[/list]

[*] Eder 22

Eder 22 is a new gun that uses 9×19mm Parabellum cartridge, and you need to find a magazine if you don't want to feed the bullets 1 by 1. It can be found all around the island, but the best locations to find it are around military and police areas.

[list]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27012442/13123a378166baf9fe1b6a7eb5410de52e14c1ff.jpg[/img]
[/list]
[/list]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27012442/bbbb7395fadc918312cd8fccca6efa992c9b7c47.png[/img]
[h1]Fortify in the name of God.[/h1]

[list]
[*] The continental church can be fortified from now on.

[list]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27012442/488e6f02054c6f6f0c0cbd71a18f965bd1bc1942.jpg[/img]
[/list]
[/list]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27012442/bbbb7395fadc918312cd8fccca6efa992c9b7c47.png[/img]

[h1]Feed me more![/h1]

[list]
[*] As cooking is being reworked, we will need to rework some other stuff as well, for starters how our fire system works. We added a new mechanic where you can add materials to your fire so it doesn't go out. It looks something like this:

[list]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27012442/84ade440ac0471b0780c96ce9b1cead4f4ba348a.jpg[/img] 
[/list]

[*] Keep in mind that there is a cap on how long the fire burns. The one in the picture burns up to 120 minutes, and different materials add more or less time, from just a few seconds up to 60 minutes. The cap can not be pushed over. If the fire has been burning for 10 minutes and you add a material that can add 60 minutes of fuel, you will only gain 10 minutes from that material. Here is a list of items that you can use:

[list]
[*] Paper - 10s

[*] Rag stripes - 15s

[*] Tinder - 30s

[*] Gun powder - 30s

[*] Rags - 30s

[*] Improvised rope - 60s

[*] Tree bark rope - 60s

[*] Short wooden stick - 1:30min

[*] Rope - 2min

[*] Long wooden stick - 5min

[*] Kitchen board - 10min

[*] Small wooden log - 30min

[*] Wooden plank - 60min
[/list]

[*] If you use an item that has uses, all uses will be depleted and the item will be destroyed

[*] In the future we want the fire to have a visual indicator of how long it's burning by changing the fire intensity. If the fire has just recently been lit, it's going to be big and roaring, and if it's almost burned up, you'll see a tiny flame. Those states will also impact cooking in the future.
[/list]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27012442/bbbb7395fadc918312cd8fccca6efa992c9b7c47.png[/img]

[h1]Bug fixes[/h1]

[list]
[*] Fixed a bug where fame wouldn't be reduced on death.

[*] Fixed a bug where if you died while leaning you would respawn in the same position.

[*] Fixed a bug where you could exit a vehicle while beside a wall, and clip through it.

[*] Fixed a bug where sled would penetrate through various objects and causing issues.

[*] Fixed a bug where sometimes you were able to loot through walls.

[*] Fixed a bug where you could pick up objects and chests through walls and ceilings.

[*] Fixed a bug where the vehicle horn would get stuck in an infinite loop.

[*] Fixed clipping issues with higher FoV values.

[*] Fixed issue where cargo activation in events happened twice, awarding double points
[/list]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27012442/bbbb7395fadc918312cd8fccca6efa992c9b7c47.png[/img]

[h1]Quality of Life changes.[/h1]

[list]
[*] Opening and closing doors now can be heard up to max 25 meters.

[*] Player footstep sounds have been lowered a bit.

[*] Added distinct sounds for switching between auto and single fire mode.


[*] Added additional checks for dragging items. Should fix the issue with using items trough walls because of clipping.

[*] Implemented scrolling trough admin command suggestions.
[/list]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27012442/bbbb7395fadc918312cd8fccca6efa992c9b7c47.png[/img]

[h1]And everything else.[/h1]

[list]
[*] Various server and client optimizations.

[*] EAC improvements.

[*] Implemented server log for chat
[/list]

That pizza shop I was talking about before? Now you'll be able to have it, and put pineapples on it, as well as other terrifying things. notes.title: A Wild Hotfix Appeared! 0.1.24.11379
notes.notes:
